name: Ningbo Sunrise Elc Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Ningbo Sunrise Elc Technology Co., Ltd. is engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sale of a broad array of products across three key segments: consumer electronics, customer premise equipment, and automotive electronics. Its consumer electronics portfolio includes items such as OA components, various sockets and connectors (including high-density and communication-focused types), electronic shields, as well as general hardware and precision-engineered products. In the customer premise equipment sector, the company provides heat sinks and external casings. Furthermore, its automotive electronics offerings encompass power and generator components, connectors, locking systems, antennas, and liquid crystal displays. This enterprise, founded in 2001, is headquartered in Cixi, China.
